description: Descriptive authoring contract, not a complete JSON Schema. Parser validation remains authoritative.
omitted_policy: Retain original turning contract and initial-stationarity rejection.
eligibility: Every authored initial velocity component equals exactly zero.
Initial separation exceeds min_distance_m plus coordinate uncertainty.
Initial coordinate uncertainty is within position_atol_m.
Absolute initial radial acceleration exceeds min_radial_acceleration_m_s2 plus arithmetic allowance.
positive_time_semantics: First detected local minimum/maximum/either, subject to original turning thresholds and numerical refinement; no global result.
centre_policy: A defined-field transit can precede a later maximum. A detected centre root is rejected; source singularities remain unqualified.
failure_policy: Local typed failures preserve unrelated observations; schema errors precede all physics.
numerical_policy: Two terminal DOP853 solves starting at t=0, second with half cap and tenfold tighter tolerances; no retries or completeness claim.
test_scope: Electric/gravity, exact rest, oblique geometry, composed sources, SC-28 unchanged rest state with an explicitly longer horizon.
